note: Fields the product has adopted since `tools/arm-config-baseline.json` was recorded, each with the dispatch that priced it. The baseline is not edited to carry them: it is the record of ONE dispatch and what that dispatch read, so writing a newer value into it would make an old reading claim a configuration it never ran. `registered-arm.test.ts` reads this file, applies every row to the baseline, and compares the result with `REGISTERED_ARM` — so the shipped arm is the measured arm plus a list of adoptions that each name their evidence, and a field adopted without one is a red build rather than a paragraph in a report.
